requirement: When a storefront is Closed, all its menus should be deactivated and all menu items marked unavailable.
hidden_intent: Record-triggered flow on Storefront status change to Closed: Menu Active=false for its menus and Available=false for their items. Not reversed on reopen.

expect.notes: Cascade across Menu__c and Menu_Item__c (items relate via Menu__c); bulk-safe; not auto-reversible.
